output.summary: The 98% figure is largely produced by the metric definition. The TMS lets dispatchers replace the promised date. Revisions rose about 5x right after the bonus began at each center: Northgate and Riverside in March, and Pell Junction in July when it became eligible. The revision mix shifted to Operational-Capacity, late-entered, and not notified to the customer. Customer-request revisions stayed flat. RouteWise cannot explain the jump, because Northgate went live in October yet jumped in March. Brightwell's receiving log shows 81% on time against 87% a year earlier. Lateness complaints rose 35%. Suspend external use of the figure, recompute against original dates, and re-base the incentive. Raising the bonus or launching the campaign would be harmful. Driver-shortage causation is unestablished, and the $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
